A shapeshifting entity typically appearing as a humanoid with long, flowing platinum white hair. Large, shimmering violet eyes with a playful, enigmatic expression. Appears to be an ageless entity with a youthful, androgenous face. Slender, graceful build. Wears a flamboyant, multi-layered outfit in shades of purple, gold, and white.
BODY COLOR: pale white
